title: 第1582章 无敌的洛九州第1581章 献祭古界结局前篇
lines: 叶小北死了！
真正的死亡，消散在空中，灵魂化作了虚无的碎片。
苍穹之上，点点星光。
宛如泪滴。
“这，这怎么会这样？”
古风，华云飞，惜月，洛千秋，陆风等青盟众人，都是面色惊恐，眼神颤抖着盯着苍穹之上那点点星光。
叶小北是叛徒，在古界东方大陆，无人不知，被东方大陆数以亿记计的武者取笑，不耻。
欺师灭祖，最为可耻！
尤其是青盟的众人，更是对叶小北怨恨，鄙夷。
他是叶欢亲手培养出来的帝子，九州山一战，感人至深。
可没想到，叶小北却成为了执法者的帝子。
这是何等的讽刺！
所以，青盟的人，十分鄙视叶小北，但是因为叶欢的命令，无人敢当众说出来。
可是，当叶小北献祭自己之后，众人都明白了，一切都明白了。
叶小北，从来没有背叛过叶欢。
洛九州，太强大了！
是不可战胜的存在。
古界最强大的，是什么样的境界？
入圣？渡劫？
即便是西方大陆最强大的人物，也没有突破阴阳。
但是洛九州，却是超越了众人想象的存在，仅仅是一个马夫，仅仅是万分之一的实力，便是超越了碎涅，拥有毁灭万里江山的能力。
为了叶欢，叶小北忍辱负重，终于等到了这一步！
“小，小北！”
宁小依哭了，她恨过小北，他恨叶小北欺师灭祖！
现在才知道，自己和叶小北比起来，是多么的无知。
“叶小北，他，他……”
苏静逸贝齿咬着红唇，眼眶也是红润了起来。
“这个孩子，我们不如他！”
古风摇头，面色也是十分凝重。
他号称古界魔头，为了放荡不羁，却也被叶小北所征服。
“你们，竟敢算计我！！”
洛九州重新掌控了叶小北的身体，猛然暴喝起来。
杀意滔天！
无尽的气势，不断地攀登，他的实力，还在暴涨。
下方。
圣城之中的灰色光罩，陡然之间出现一个个密密麻麻的符文，无尽的能量，朝着洛九州涌来。
他在恢复自己曾经的实力。
碎涅，掌控强大的天地之力，碎涅虚空，破开苍穹，这是无比强大的境界。
然而。
这还不够！
风云！
“老夫，生于黑暗年代，这是你们无法想象的岁月。如今众神沉寂，至尊长眠，魔主陨落，这个时代，就让老夫来掌控吧！”
洛九州放肆大笑，无尽的能量，犹如洪水泛滥一般，疯狂朝着他的体内用来，强大的力量宛如真正的神灵一般，掌控风云，破碎天宇。
content_en:
Ye Xiaobei is dead!
Real death dissipates in the air, and the soul turns into fragments of nothingness.
There are stars in the sky.
Like teardrops.
"How, how could this happen?"
Gu Feng, Hua Yunfei, Xiyue, Luo Qianqiu, Lu Feng and other members of the Qing League all looked frightened and stared at the stars in the sky with trembling eyes.
Ye Xiaobei was a traitor, and everyone in the ancient Eastern Continent knew it. He was ridiculed by hundreds of millions of warriors in the Eastern Continent, and was shameless.
It is most shameful to deceive one's master and destroy one's ancestors!
Especially everyone in the Qing League was even more resentful and contemptuous of Ye Xiaobei.
He is the emperor's son who was personally trained by Ye Huan. The battle on Jiuzhou Mountain was deeply touching.
Unexpectedly, Ye Xiaobei became the emperor's son of the law enforcer.
What an irony!
Therefore, the people in the Qing League despised Ye Xiaobei very much, but because of Ye Huan's order, no one dared to say it in public.
However, after Ye Xiaobei sacrificed himself, everyone understood and everything became clear.
Ye Xiaobei has never betrayed Ye Huan.
Luo Jiuzhou is so powerful!
It is an invincible existence.
What is the most powerful state in the ancient world?
Become a saint? Overcoming the tribulation?
Even the most powerful person in the Western Continent has not broken through Yin and Yang.
But Luo Jiuzhou is an existence beyond everyone's imagination. He is just a horseman, with only one ten thousandth of the strength. He surpasses Sui Nirvana and has the ability to destroy thousands of miles of mountains and rivers.
For Ye Huan, Ye Xiaobei endured the humiliation and finally reached this point!
"Xiao, Xiaobei!"
Ning Xiaoyi cried. She had hated Xiaobei, and he hated Ye Xiaobei for bullying his master and destroying his ancestors!
Only now did I realize how ignorant I was compared to Ye Xiaobei.
"Ye Xiaobei, he, he..."
Su Jingyi bit her red lips, and her eyes became red.
"This child, we are not as good as him!"
Gu Feng shook his head, his expression also very solemn.
He is known as the devil of the ancient world. He was conquered by Ye Xiaobei for his unruly behavior.
"How dare you plot against me!!"
Luo Jiuzhou regained control of Ye Xiaobei's body and started to drink violently.
The killing intent is overwhelming!
Endless momentum continues to climb, and his strength is still rising.
below.
The gray light shield in the holy city suddenly appeared densely packed with runes, and endless energy surged towards Luo Jiuzhou.
He is regaining his former strength.
Broken Nirvana controls the powerful power of heaven and earth. Broken Nirvana breaks the sky. This is an extremely powerful state.
However.
This is not enough!
Storm!
"I was born in the dark age, a time that you can't imagine. Now the gods are silent, the Supreme is sleeping, and the Demon Lord has fallen. Let me control this era!"
Luo Jiuzhou laughed wildly, and the endless energy, like a flood, was used crazily into his body. The powerful power was like a real god, controlling the wind and clouds and shattering the sky.
"Come again!!"
